group.description: the group's genesis digest in its canonical u form (47 characters, Identity 6.1)

member.description: the sender's member anchor in group

memberOp.description: oid: of the canonical admission of member, or of the genesis where the sender founded the group

to.description: the recipient's pair anchor of the tuple the group star travels on

salt.description: the salt of the group star that carries this pair

proof.description: HMAC(HKDF(ECDH(memberX_sender, pairX_recipient), "rltp/visibility/mac/group-pair"), canonical bytes of this object without proof); memberX_sender is the key-agreement key of the card enclosed in the operation memberOp names

title: RLTP group-pair@1 (rltp-visibility@0.30)
description: The opened body of a sealed group-star entry (Network Visibility 5.2b): it proves, to the recipient alone, control of the sender's member anchor in one group the recipient is a current member of. Class V: never republished, never carried into a group space, never evidence toward a third party.
